question: Should Gitcrawl accept the v5 sync_attempt_failures SQLite ledger and the new sync-failures/coverage JSON contract as the supported upgrade path for this release?
rationale: The code path appears narrow and correct, but durable schema versions and CLI JSON contracts are compatibility/product commitments that automation should not approve on its own.

options.title: Approve the v5 ledger contract
options.body: Accept the schemaVersion 5 migration and the new read-only CLI/coverage JSON fields, then merge after normal checks are green.

options.title: Request a compatibility adjustment
options.body: Ask for a narrower upgrade/documentation/proof change before merge if maintainers want a different schema or JSON contract.

options.title: Pause the ledger feature
options.body: Defer or close this PR if the repository is not ready to add a new durable failure-ledger table yet.

recommendation.title: Approve the v5 ledger contract
recommendation.body: Accept the schemaVersion 5 migration and the new read-only CLI/coverage JSON fields, then merge after normal checks are green.
